description: This is a C++ source file implementing the PersistentStore class, which provides methods to register, unregister, and handle persistent key-value store operations via RPC endpoints, including get/set values, delete keys/namespaces, retrieve keys/namespaces, and manage storage sizes and limits.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A class managing persistent key-value storage with RPC endpoints, including registration, unregistration, and various get/set/delete operations.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints related to the persistent store operations.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all previously registered RPC endpoints.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store for a given key and namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL from the store for a given key and namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Gets storage sizes per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.
